description: Hire a listed skill. Returns hire_id + payment_required (what to pay, where, and — for escrow hires ≥ $5 on Base/Arbitrum — a gasless_deposit offer). Then call pay_hire. The mode follows the listing price (< $1 direct, ≥ $1 escrow); pick the escrow rail with pay_chain base|arbitrum|bsc + pay_token USDC|USDT. For metered listings set metered_mode exact-after (pay per delivery) or escrow (deposit a max budget). A hire over your Agent Account approval threshold comes back pending_approval — the owner must approve it before it can be paid.
name: create_hire
title: Create a hire (step 1 of hiring)
